claim_boundary: This boundary records prompt/context readiness criteria tied to the bounded prompt/context-system matrix, plus a claim guard for each prompt surface. It does not claim a prompt-role capability matrix, deterministic context summarization, all-role provider-token section packing, separate prompt-format source provenance, full prompt replay-retention policy, audit-grade retrieval source integrity, semantic proposal memory, calibrated meta-prompt rewards, prompt-database archive lifecycle, prompt/context benchmark evidence, stale-readiness detector, or owner review signoff.

prompt_context_claim_guard.allowed_current_claim: mutation-template schema/dry-run checks and bounded role evidence
prompt_context_claim_guard.missing_before_parity_claim: prompt-role capability matrix proving role-specific template compatibility and ownership
prompt_context_claim_guard.prompt_surface: mutation, critique, feedback, meta-prompt, and custom role templates

prompt_context_claim_guard.allowed_current_claim: deterministic include/source provenance and first-N truncation
